question: Which surah warns humanity about their ingratitude to Allah and extreme love of worldly wealth?

english_translation: Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord
question: What does the word لَكَنُودٌ mean in Surah Al-Adiyat?
Surah Al-Adiyat opens with an oath by which of the following?

english_translation: striking sparks of fire with their hoofs
question: According to Surah Al-Adiyat, what do the horses strike with their hoofs?

arabic_text: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
english_translation: Do they not know that when the contents of the graves will be spilled out, and the secrets of the hearts will be laid bare
question: What key concept about the Day of Judgment does Surah Al-Adiyat emphasize?

options.A: All deeds will be weighed on scales
options.B: The secrets of hearts will be revealed and Allah is All-Aware
options.C: The earth will be flattened completely
options.D: People will be given their records in their hands
